purpose: Verify creation of user account with a unique Institute ID.
preconditions: Institute ID 'INST-1001' does not exist in Fusion.
action_or_input: Submit user creation request for Student with Institute ID 'INST-1001', valid institute email, program, and batch.
expected_result: User account created successfully with assigned Institute ID 'INST-1001'.

purpose: Verify rejection of user creation when Institute ID already exists.
preconditions: User account with Institute ID 'INST-1001' already exists in Fusion.
action_or_input: Submit user creation request for Student with duplicate Institute ID 'INST-1001'.
expected_result: User creation request rejected due to non-unique Institute ID.

purpose: Verify rejection of any attempt to change an existing Institute ID during profile update.
preconditions: User profile exists with Institute ID 'INST-1001'.
action_or_input: Submit profile update attempting to change Institute ID from 'INST-1001' to 'INST-9999'.
expected_result: Profile update rejected; Institute ID remains immutable.

purpose: Verify acceptance of user account creation with a valid institute email address.
preconditions: Institute ID is unique.
action_or_input: Submit user creation request with institute email 'user@iiitdmj.ac.in'.
expected_result: User account created successfully.

purpose: Verify rejection of user account creation or update with a non-institute email address.
preconditions: User profile creation/update submitted.
action_or_input: Submit user email as 'user@gmail.com'.
expected_result: Operation rejected due to invalid institute email domain/format.

purpose: Verify student creation succeeds when program, batch, and common mandatory data are present.
preconditions: Institute ID and institute email are unique and valid.
action_or_input: Create Student user with program 'B.Tech CSE', batch '2024', and common mandatory fields.
expected_result: Student user account created successfully.

purpose: Verify Faculty/Staff creation succeeds when employee ID, department, and common mandatory data are present.
preconditions: Institute ID and institute email are unique and valid.
action_or_input: Create Faculty user with employee ID 'EMP-501', department 'CSE', and common mandatory fields.
expected_result: Faculty user account created successfully.

purpose: Verify rejection of user creation when type-required data is missing.
preconditions: None.
action_or_input: Create Student user without program and batch information.
expected_result: User creation rejected with report of missing/invalid mandatory fields.

purpose: Verify archival of deactivated user after min deactivation interval and no pending transactions.
preconditions: User account status is 'Deactivated', min deactivation interval has elapsed, 0 pending transactions exist.
action_or_input: Submit archival request for the eligible deactivated user.
expected_result: User account is successfully archived.

purpose: Verify rejection of user archival request for an active user.
preconditions: User account status is 'Active'.
action_or_input: Submit archival request for the active user account.
expected_result: Archival request rejected with reason indicating user is not deactivated.

purpose: Verify rejection of user archival when configured deactivation interval has not elapsed.
preconditions: User is deactivated, but deactivation time is less than the configured minimum deactivation interval.
action_or_input: Submit archival request for the user.
expected_result: Archival request rejected with reason indicating minimum deactivation interval not met.

purpose: Verify rejection of user archival when user has pending transactions.
preconditions: User is deactivated and deactivation interval has elapsed, but has pending transactions.
action_or_input: Submit archival request for the user.
expected_result: Archival request rejected with reason detailing pending operational transactions.

purpose: Verify restoration of an archived user within the reversible period with required authorization.
preconditions: User account is archived; current time is within configured reversible window; valid authorization present.
action_or_input: Submit user restore request for the archived user.
expected_result: Archived user account restored successfully.

purpose: Verify rejection of user restoration after the reversible period has expired.
preconditions: User account is archived; current time exceeds the configured reversible window.
action_or_input: Submit user restore request for the archived user with valid authorization.
expected_result: Restoration request rejected; account remains permanently archived and non-restorable.

purpose: Verify rejection of user restoration within reversible window when required authorization is missing.
preconditions: User account is archived; current time is within configured reversible window; request lacks authorization.
action_or_input: Submit user restore request without required authorization.
expected_result: Restoration request rejected due to missing authorization.

purpose: Verify that a user can be assigned multiple non-conflicting non-singular additional roles simultaneously.
preconditions: User holds Role A (non-singular, compatible with Role B).
action_or_input: Assign Role B to the user.
expected_result: Role B assigned successfully; user holds both Role A and Role B simultaneously.

purpose: Verify successful assignment of a singular role when no active holder currently exists for the scope.
preconditions: Singular Role 'Warden_Hall1' has no active holder.
action_or_input: Assign Role 'Warden_Hall1' to User X.
expected_result: Role 'Warden_Hall1' assigned successfully to User X.

purpose: Verify rejection of singular role assignment when an active holder already exists for the same scope.
preconditions: Singular Role 'Warden_Hall1' has an active holder User X.
action_or_input: Assign Role 'Warden_Hall1' to User Y for the same scope.
expected_result: Role assignment rejected due to singular role occupancy constraint.

purpose: Verify role assignment succeeds with start date when role is permanent (no end date required).
preconditions: Target user is eligible.
action_or_input: Assign permanent additional role with valid start date and reason.
expected_result: Role assignment accepted.

purpose: Verify role assignment succeeds with both start date and end date for time-bound role.
preconditions: Target user is eligible.
action_or_input: Assign time-bound role with valid start date and valid end date.
expected_result: Role assignment accepted.

purpose: Verify rejection of role assignment missing a start date.
preconditions: Target user is eligible.
action_or_input: Submit role assignment without specifying start date.
expected_result: Role assignment rejected due to missing mandatory start date.

purpose: Verify rejection of time-bound role assignment missing an end date.
preconditions: Role metadata defines role as time-bound.
action_or_input: Submit time-bound role assignment specifying start date but omitting end date.
expected_result: Role assignment rejected due to missing mandatory end date for time-bound role.

purpose: Verify automatic activation of a future-dated role assignment on its start date.
preconditions: User has a scheduled role assignment with start date equal to current system date.
action_or_input: Trigger system date arrival / daily lifecycle batch for start date.
expected_result: Role status changes automatically to Active and effective access is granted without manual Super Admin action.

purpose: Verify automatic expiry of a time-bound role on its end date.
preconditions: User holds an active time-bound role with end date equal to current system date.
action_or_input: Trigger system date arrival / daily lifecycle batch for end date.
expected_result: Role status changes automatically to Expired and effective access is removed.

purpose: Verify assignment of a role to a user type allowed by role eligibility metadata.
preconditions: Role metadata allows assignment to user type 'Faculty'.
action_or_input: Assign role to a user with type 'Faculty'.
expected_result: Role assignment validated and created.

purpose: Verify rejection of assignment when a Faculty/Staff-specific role is assigned to a Student.
preconditions: Role metadata restricts role to 'Faculty'.
action_or_input: Assign role to a user with type 'Student'.
expected_result: Role assignment rejected identifying eligibility conflict.

purpose: Verify assignment of a role when no compatibility or scope conflict exists.
preconditions: User holds Role A; proposed Role B has no configured conflict with Role A.
action_or_input: Assign Role B to user.
expected_result: Assignment passes conflict check and is created.

purpose: Verify rejection of role assignment that violates configured role conflict metadata.
preconditions: User holds Role A; metadata configures Role A and Role B as mutually exclusive.
action_or_input: Assign Role B to user.
expected_result: Role assignment rejected with specific role conflict report.

purpose: Verify atomic reassignment handover: pending tasks transferred, old access revoked, new access granted without overlapping singular active access.
preconditions: User A holds singular Role R with pending tasks; User B is eligible for Role R.
action_or_input: Reassign Role R from User A to User B with effective date.
expected_result: On effective date, pending tasks transferred to User B, User A access removed, User B access granted; singular role never has two active holders.

purpose: Verify previous holder retains read-only audit access to prior actions within the configured audit period.
preconditions: Role reassigned away from User A 10 days ago (within audit period).
action_or_input: User A accesses prior actions log performed during tenure of former role.
expected_result: Read-only access to prior action logs granted.

purpose: Verify previous holder cannot perform operational actions under reassigned role.
preconditions: Role reassigned away from User A.
action_or_input: User A attempts to execute a new task/approval for former role.
expected_result: Access denied; no operational role authority retained.

purpose: Verify read-only access to prior actions is denied after configured audit period elapses.
preconditions: Role reassigned away from User A; time elapsed exceeds configured audit period.
action_or_input: User A attempts to view prior action logs for the reassigned role.
expected_result: Read-only audit access expired and access denied.

purpose: Verify standard revocation enforcement with at least 1 day notice, mandatory reason, and task disposition.
preconditions: User holds active role.
action_or_input: Schedule standard revocation 2 days in future, with mandatory reason and task disposition set to 'transfer'.
expected_result: Standard revocation scheduled and executed on effective date with chosen task handling.

purpose: Verify rejection of standard role revocation scheduled with less than one day notice.
preconditions: User holds active role.
action_or_input: Schedule standard revocation with effective date 2 hours from current time.
expected_result: Revocation rejected due to failure to meet minimum 1-day notice requirement for standard revocation.

purpose: Verify emergency revocation bypasses standard notice period and executes immediately.
preconditions: User holds active role.
action_or_input: Submit emergency revocation with reason and task disposition set to 'close'.
expected_result: Role access revoked immediately without requiring 1-day notice period.

purpose: Verify automatic revocation of all assigned active roles when a user account is deactivated.
preconditions: User has active assigned roles.
action_or_input: Deactivate the user account.
expected_result: All active roles for the user are automatically revoked/inactivated and access history is preserved.

purpose: Verify expiry reminders generated for time-bound roles at configured lead time.
preconditions: Time-bound role end date is within configured lead time window.
action_or_input: Execute notification trigger service.
expected_result: Expiry reminder generated and dispatched to role holder and relevant admin.

purpose: Verify valid role extension with new end date and reason.
preconditions: Role is active or approaching expiry.
action_or_input: Submit role extension request with a later end date and valid reason.
expected_result: Role validity end date updated successfully and assignment history updated.

purpose: Verify rejection of role extension missing a new end date or reason.
preconditions: Role is approaching expiry.
action_or_input: Submit role extension omitting mandatory reason.
expected_result: Extension request rejected due to missing mandatory field.

purpose: Verify historical data archival when retention age, business cycle completion, and dependencies are met.
preconditions: Historical data meets retention age, business cycle completed, 0 open dependencies.
action_or_input: Submit historical data archival request.
expected_result: Historical data archived successfully.

purpose: Verify rejection of historical data archival when dependency or transaction completion criteria fail.
preconditions: Historical data has unresolved dependency/pending action.
action_or_input: Submit historical data archival request for specified range.
expected_result: Archival request rejected with report of dependency/blocking reasons.

purpose: Verify audit logs are excluded from historical data archival execution.
preconditions: Audit log records submitted in archival target range.
action_or_input: Submit historical data archival request specifying category containing audit logs.
expected_result: Archival excludes audit logs, preserving them in primary permanent store.

purpose: Verify historical data archival proceeds after successful data backup creation.
preconditions: Backup service returns success.
action_or_input: Confirm and initiate eligible historical data archival.
expected_result: Data backup created, followed by data movement to archive database.

purpose: Verify historical data archival aborts if pre-archival backup fails.
preconditions: Backup service fails / returns error.
action_or_input: Confirm and initiate eligible historical data archival.
expected_result: Archival operation aborted; no data moved to archive database.

purpose: Verify archived data is retained and preserved throughout policy retention duration.
preconditions: Data archived; retention age less than policy retention duration.
action_or_input: Query archived data status.
expected_result: Archived data remains intact and available in archive store.

purpose: Verify purge request is rejected while archived data retention period has not elapsed.
preconditions: Archived data retention period has not expired.
action_or_input: Request purge of archived data.
expected_result: Purge operation blocked by retention policy constraint.

purpose: Verify archived records accessed via SA archive interface are strictly read-only and enforce data isolation.
preconditions: Super Admin searches/retrieves archived user metadata.
action_or_input: View archived user profile and attempt inline edit on metadata.
expected_result: Archived data displayed in read-only mode; edit operation unavailable/rejected.

purpose: Verify permanent purge request is accepted for evaluation after retention period has fully elapsed.
preconditions: Archived data retention period has fully expired.
action_or_input: Submit permanent purge request for expired archived data.
expected_result: Purge request accepted for dual-authorization workflow.

purpose: Verify rejection of permanent purge request for data still within retention period.
preconditions: Archived data retention period has NOT expired.
action_or_input: Submit permanent purge request.
expected_result: Purge request rejected immediately due to unexpired retention period.

purpose: Verify permanent purge executes when authorized by both Super Admin and IT Head.
preconditions: Purge-eligible data requested by Super Admin; IT Head pending approval.
action_or_input: IT Head submits positive authorization for the purge request.
expected_result: Permanent purge executes; data permanently removed.

purpose: Verify permanent purge does not execute with only Super Admin request without IT Head approval.
preconditions: Purge-eligible data requested by Super Admin; IT Head authorization missing/rejected.
action_or_input: Attempt purge execution prior to IT Head approval or upon IT Head rejection.
expected_result: Purge execution blocked; data remains safely archived.

purpose: Verify role assignment notification is dispatched to affected user within 1 hour of effective operation.
preconditions: Role assignment becomes effective at T0.
action_or_input: Check dispatch log timestamp T1 for role assignment notification.
expected_result: Notification dispatched with (T1 - T0) <= 1 hour.

purpose: Verify role revocation notification is dispatched to affected user within 1 hour of effective operation.
preconditions: Role revocation becomes effective at T0.
action_or_input: Check dispatch log timestamp T1 for role revocation notification.
expected_result: Notification dispatched with (T1 - T0) <= 1 hour.

purpose: Verify failed login attempts are logged but do not trigger security alert when count is below 5.
preconditions: Super Admin login failed 4 consecutive times.
action_or_input: Observe system alert log and alert dispatch.
expected_result: 4 failed login attempts logged; security alert is NOT triggered.

purpose: Verify security alert is triggered upon 5 consecutive failed login attempts.
preconditions: Super Admin login failed 4 consecutive times.
action_or_input: Perform 5th consecutive failed login attempt.
expected_result: 5th failure logged; security alert triggered and dispatched via configured critical channels (including optional SMS if enabled).

purpose: Verify Super Admin audit logs cannot be altered or deleted.
preconditions: Audit entries exist in system.
action_or_input: Attempt database UPDATE or DELETE SQL command against Super Admin audit log tables.
expected_result: Operation rejected; audit log records remain unaltered.

purpose: Verify expired role assignment history remains permanently retained in audit history.
preconditions: Role expired 5 years ago.
action_or_input: Query historical audit records for the expired role assignment.
expected_result: Role assignment history records successfully retrieved.

purpose: Verify Super Admin can access user profile metadata, role info, audit logs, and archive metadata.
preconditions: Super Admin logged in.
action_or_input: Access user profile list, role list, and audit log viewer.
expected_result: Access granted to permitted identity, role, and audit metadata.

purpose: Verify Super Admin is denied access to operational content (grades, financial details, medical records).
preconditions: Super Admin logged in.
action_or_input: Attempt direct query or endpoint access to student grades, financial transactions, or medical records.
expected_result: Access denied due to Super Admin data isolation boundary enforcement.

purpose: Verify Super Admin login succeeds with strong password and valid 2FA.
preconditions: Super Admin credentials valid; 2FA configured.
action_or_input: Submit valid username, strong password, and correct 2FA code.
expected_result: Super Admin authenticated and session established.

purpose: Verify Super Admin login fails if 2FA code is omitted or invalid.
preconditions: Super Admin credentials valid.
action_or_input: Submit valid username and password without 2FA code.
expected_result: Login denied due to mandatory 2FA requirement.

purpose: Verify single active Super Admin session rule by rejecting second concurrent login.
preconditions: Super Admin active session exists on Device A.
action_or_input: Authenticate Super Admin account on Device B.
expected_result: Second session establishment rejected or prior session terminated per single-session policy.

purpose: Verify Super Admin session is terminated after configured inactivity timeout.
preconditions: Super Admin session active; no user activity for configured timeout duration.
action_or_input: Submit subsequent HTTP request after timeout elapses.
expected_result: Session invalidated; user redirected to authentication prompt.

purpose: Verify Super Admin cannot grant, revoke, or modify their own Super Admin status in-module.
preconditions: Logged in as Super Admin User SA1.
action_or_input: Submit request via module to modify SA1's Super Admin role/status.
expected_result: Operation rejected; self-modification of Super Admin status prohibited in-module.

purpose: Verify critical operation executes after successful reauthentication confirmation.
preconditions: Super Admin initiates critical operation (e.g., historical data archival / purge request).
action_or_input: Prompted for password/auth confirmation; submit correct authentication credentials.
expected_result: Critical operation authenticated and executed.

purpose: Verify critical operation is aborted if reauthentication fails or is cancelled.
preconditions: Super Admin initiates critical operation.
action_or_input: Submit invalid password on confirmation prompt.
expected_result: Critical operation aborted; no action executed.

purpose: Verify bulk user operation succeeds when record count is 1000.
preconditions: CSV file contains exactly 1000 valid user records.
action_or_input: Submit bulk user creation request with 1000 records.
expected_result: Bulk operation validated and processed.

purpose: Verify bulk user operation is rejected when record count exceeds 1000.
preconditions: CSV file contains 1001 user records.
action_or_input: Submit bulk user creation request with 1001 records.
expected_result: Bulk operation rejected due to exceeding 1000 record bulk operation limit.

purpose: Verify password change is enforced when Super Admin password age reaches configured rotation interval.
preconditions: Super Admin password age equals configured rotation interval.
action_or_input: Super Admin attempts authentication.
expected_result: System requires mandatory password change before granting module access.

purpose: Verify supported events dispatch email and in-system notifications, and optional SMS for critical alerts.
preconditions: Notification preferences enabled for email, in-system, and optional SMS.
action_or_input: Trigger role assignment event and critical security alert event.
expected_result: Role assignment sends email + in-system notification; security alert dispatches email + in-system + SMS.

purpose: Verify audit log entry records all mandatory fields upon auditable event.
preconditions: Auditable event occurs (e.g., user status change).
action_or_input: Execute user deactivation.
expected_result: Audit entry created containing timestamp, actor ID, action, target, IP address, result, and reason.

purpose: Verify basic user can select an assigned active role and receive corresponding permissions.
preconditions: User assigned active Role 'HOD_CSE'.
action_or_input: User selects 'HOD_CSE' as active role.
expected_result: Active role context set to 'HOD_CSE' and permissions granted.

purpose: Verify user cannot select an expired, revoked, or unassigned role as active context.
preconditions: User's role 'Lab_Incharge' is expired/revoked.
action_or_input: User attempts to switch active role context to 'Lab_Incharge'.
expected_result: Role selection rejected; effective module access denied.

purpose: Verify Super Admin can update permitted parameters (password policy, session timeout, retention limits).
preconditions: Super Admin logged in.
action_or_input: Submit update for session timeout duration within institutional policy bounds.
expected_result: Configuration updated successfully.

purpose: Verify Super Admin cannot modify excluded configuration categories (academic calendars, financial rules, workflows).
preconditions: Super Admin logged in.
action_or_input: Attempt to update academic calendar schedule or financial policy workflow configuration.
expected_result: Configuration change rejected as outside Super Admin administrative boundary.
